book.name: Mikiyasa
book.title: Mikiyasarini kuku Nuw Mikiyasi Apanllee kuku kamanchintspa

content: Ashiriya, na kamanchintspa, yuwaa Apanll Israelshuchee wanimaam zandarangu, nuwaa Mikiyasaatsi tsiyatarangu anootsi

Ashiriya Israelchichis, Apanllee kuk mazinangints. Apanll ateeja: Siysa nuwaa kamaningandama, yuwaa yutari ashkis anootsi. Ashiriya chiyzangints. Itsinsarus kamaningandama. Ngichintspa. Mach íwar, mishat mach tsipastam, tsaputam yuwaa kuruzkachis anoo mazinachinllinaya. Watam ichinguroo yasakanawa.
Nuw siyaa tputsireetseeruri atina. Natu kamaningandama. ¿Ashinooja nuw siyaa tayutaritarangee?

Napa: Zitaminaris Ijiptosh tsap taarusin, kiyung kachiykusin, nuwsha anoo tapachindarangi. Ijipto tsap tashitungarangina. Móysisee, misha Aaronaa wizarpatari Mariypat siyaa ksutamaam zanganirangina. ¿Anoo nda yasaksa? ¿Tamaysha mbizaksa?

Mishat, Mowabshuch urkar Balaka sur, zitaminarineetsis ichinguru kachingamaam zandarangu, Balamarinee, Beorarinee wip istamaam kuruzurangiya. Itaru, Balamarinsha, nuwaa kuki Balakaa itsinsaru kamanirangu istamaam ngatarangiya. ¿Tamaysha anootstam mbizaksa? Mishat, yakat Sitimamand kasayarandsin, Guilgaalap naatarangsin, nuwsha wanip siyashchimari kasimaam istarangina. ¿Siyaa wanip tapachindarangina? atina. Ashiri na siysa kamaningtsa, tárangiya Apanlli. Itaru, nuwsha Mikiyasi atina.

¿Ashiriya Apaa, Iy Israelchichini shiyaa tsiyatkuni ameecheezini, iya? Shiy ichingaru kasiru kurakish taaksha. Shiy taarashipantishcha. ¿Maypataja shiyash pangish pshtuchini shiyaa ungirtamaama? ¿Maypataja iyaa yutaritshishirini tachingeechish? Wakarareetsini karupana pachayaruni, muchkitaateeniya ¿antaati shiy anpat yutaritshishireetsini tachingcheezish? Nda.

Misha ¿antaati opeejaa karupana miltaati muchkuri, mishat dies mil litorutaati wayungunu tazukuri anoo zandcheezish? ¿Nduniya ashiru ipareetstaati iwaxiztama yutaritshishireetsi tachingamaam pachaktaateena anoo shiy zandcheezish? Nda.

Apaa, sirútama iyaa tputsireetsish yuw shiyaam wanasiri anoo kamanirangsha. Ashiri Apaa, tárangsha: Siy tputsis saanpatatis itsinsarus tsiyateerus wanasiriri tángtsa. Mishat, tputs wanguytaku anoo istangtsa. Ichingaroo tputs nayaningtsa. Ashkchus wanasir taatssa. Mishat, nuwaatsimari mangiptartis chinakus, k'keetsi payungtsa, tárangsha Apaa, nuw Mikiyasi tárangina.

Itaru, iyashuch shiyaa kukish payumaam nda zandkana. Ashiri nuw Mikiyasi, atina: Iy Apanllirini Irusarinshucheetsis ateeja: Yuwis mangis kapunguwa anis nuwaa waneeshi kamungamaam zandkeesa, kaapaniri mangiptis mazinangtsa. Kurakshtis wanimpanis tputsirpatartis mazinangtsa.
Tputs yutaritshishpan kurikangazimari chinaksin, pangush maachee zapan yuw shuchikana an payukanaya. Mishat, maachta tupaxanxaksin, kapung kiloo shuchikana. Anoo nuw natsakina.
Kurikpan tputs pukiree kiyung yachakanaya. Irusarinshuch tputs ichingarusin waanpatatin tamapingayarusin shuchikanaya.
Ashiriya, na siyaa yutaritshishirimandis wanichintspa. Maachiritaatsis ichingaru kurikireetsis itutseeruri izuuru ndunarsha kasachintspa.

Katungitaateesa ndusha tazazakus, kizpur mariztatssa. Tatsumareetsis pusakitaateesa, tputssha uru shuchichiya. Pakich yuw saama ituchkis anootssha nda pishumaam waritakus, kundararshtis ichinguru itutschiya.
Tirikootssha tatsumkitaateesa nda pusamaam waritatssa. Wanusee pusayarus, wayunganoom tatsirapshiyarus yataris ndusha ashitssa. Mishat, kizarunaa pusayarus, wakungur waamaam yataris ndusha ashitssa.

Siy Irusarinshuchis Israelchich urkar Umri sura tamapari ashirus kizpur yutarit taaksa. Kurak Ajabarinitam, maachiritpa yutarit taarangana, siysa na ashiritam yutari taaksa. Ashiri yuwamand yutarit ashkis, anumand siyaa tpachingachintspa. Ashkachuri, minchich tputs zapan siyaa yasaksin, kizpur puniksin, siyachchee michitkusin stachinllinaya. Ashiri siyamand yutaritshishiris Israelchich tputs ichingarusin pazichinllinaya, atina, Apanll tárangiya nuwaa Mikiyasaatsi. Ashiriya, na kamaneena yuwaa Apanll Israelshuchee wanimaam zandarangu, nuwaa Mikiyasaatsi tsiyatarangu anootsi.
